description: Off-screen dawn economy LOD: stock flows, broken-route despair, starve pressure. Deterministic; no spark spend beyond cost_town_despair.

extractiveDefaults.note: Used only when route.extractive and receiveShare missing a town key

despair.note: Must not restore pre-pacing spark fuse; cost_town_despair stays -1

neglect.note: Town untouched (no interaction/reignite there) for graceDawns adds onNeglect, never above neglectCap; never a fail state.

flameRelief.note: Each dawn a town's despair falls by perDawn x (share of residents at or above the reignite threshold), once at least minShare burn. Neglect (+0.01) still applies, so a town needs about half its people lit to brighten on its own.

determinism: same seed + same dawn sequence => same stock/despair vectors
